description: Add git worktree support for lightweight, parallel feature development without container overhead

userStories.title: Create worktree.sh with basic create and run functionality
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to create a git worktree and run Claude Code in it so that I can work on features in isolation without container overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Create worktree.sh script in project root
Running `./worktree.sh <feature-name>` creates worktree at ../ralph-worktrees/<feature-name>
Script auto-detects default branch (main/master/trunk) using git symbolic-ref
Script creates branch `ralph/<feature-name>` from detected default branch
Script validates feature name: only alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores allowed
Script rejects invalid names with helpful error message
Script creates parent directory `../ralph-worktrees/` if it doesn't exist
Script changes to worktree directory and runs Claude Code with --dangerously-skip-permissions
Script prints security warning banner: 'WARNING: Worktree mode runs with full host filesystem access'
If worktree already exists, script uses existing worktree without error
Script detects if git worktree command is available, exits with helpful message if not
Script provides helpful error when branch is already checked out elsewhere
Script follows existing patterns from sandbox.sh (colors, header banners)
Script is executable (chmod +x)

manualChecks: Run ./worktree.sh test-feature and verify worktree is created
Verify invalid name './worktree.sh my feature' shows error

userStories.notes: Core functionality with Bart's critical fixes: default branch detection, name validation, security warning

userStories.title: Add worktree --list command
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to list all ralph worktrees so that I can see what feature branches I have active.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `--list` flag that shows all worktrees in ../ralph-worktrees/
List shows: name, branch, path, and status (clean/dirty)
Status shows if worktree has uncommitted changes
If no worktrees exist, show helpful message instead of empty output
Output is formatted for readability with alignment
Bash syntax check passes: bash -n worktree.sh

manualChecks: Create a worktree, verify it appears in --list
Verify --list with zero worktrees shows helpful message

userStories.notes: Split from original US-002 per Bart's recommendation

userStories.title: Add worktree --create command
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to create a worktree without immediately starting Claude Code so I can set it up first.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `--create <name>` flag that creates worktree without running Claude Code
Uses same validation and branch creation as default command
Shows path to created worktree for easy navigation
Suggests next steps: 'cd ../ralph-worktrees/<name> to start working'
Bash syntax check passes: bash -n worktree.sh

manualChecks: Run ./worktree.sh --create test-create and verify worktree exists but Claude not started

userStories.notes: Split from original US-002 per Bart's recommendation. Added --create/-c flag with full validation and helpful next steps output.

userStories.title: Add worktree --remove command with safety checks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to safely remove worktrees so that I can clean up finished feature work.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `--remove <name>` flag that removes a worktree
Prompts for confirmation before deleting
Warns and requires --force if worktree has uncommitted changes
Offers option to also delete the branch (default: no)
Error handling for removing non-existent worktree
Does NOT delete remote branches (local only)
Bash syntax check passes: bash -n worktree.sh

manualChecks: Create worktree, add uncommitted changes, verify --remove warns about dirty state

userStories.notes: Added --remove/-r command with comprehensive safety: confirmation prompt, dirty worktree detection (requires --force), optional --delete-branch for local branch cleanup, clear instructions for remote branch deletion.
